P_0x0098E1: The "Lord of Ruin" that emerged via the Antarctic ruins "Fabla Foresse." It erased researcher Felio Radcliff's soul and took his body, feeding on fear, despair, rage, and sorrow to ruin all things.
P_0x009A89: After high school he took up part-time jobs and volunteer work. Dry on the surface, but an earnest, good-natured young man - clean-cut, caring, if stubborn once set on something. Skilled in worldly know-how and old club karate.
P_0x009C7D: A scientist researching System LIOH with her father, Kaoru Toumine. She grieves a world of conflict, but isolated research left her out of touch.
P_0x009DA6: Pilot of the Flickerei Geist. A calm girl with a body beyond ordinary humans, skilled at piloting mobile weapons.
P_0x009E86: Pilot of the Ares Geist. Brilliant, proud, fierce, aggressive. Deeply bonded with Ariel Org.
P_0x009F48: A boy who escaped the sealed <Aidoneus Island>. Quiet, few words. Shows rare talent piloting mobile weapons. His past is a mystery.
